requirements.requirement: The final project is a local-first reference runtime for reliable tool-using AI agents, not a generic chatbot or framework clone.
Use one LangGraph stateful agent topology with bounded execution.
Python 3.12 + FastAPI/Pydantic is the backend application surface.
Ollama qwen3:4b is the mandatory real local chat acceptance path.
Ollama qwen3-embedding:0.6b is the default local embedding path.
A generic OpenAI-compatible chat provider supports configurable vLLM without graph changes.
PostgreSQL + pgvector + PostgreSQL FTS implement hybrid RAG.
RAG evidence is source-identified and final citations may only reference retrieved evidence.
Use the official MCP Python SDK and exactly five OpsDesk tools defined by the runtime contract.
Trusted policy is authoritative; MCP annotations/model/RAG/tool output/memory cannot grant permissions.
Every side-effecting action requires exact action-bound approval.
Action argument drift invalidates an approval.
Side effects use idempotency keys and durable effect receipts to prevent duplicates.
Durability is proven through a real fresh-process restart using Postgres checkpoints.
Long-term memory is distinct from thread state and cannot authorize actions.
OpenTelemetry is mandatory; proprietary observability services are optional.
Hard security/reliability evals use deterministic/environment oracles rather than LLM-as-judge.
All mandatory S01-S12 scenarios are executable and retain evidence.
Default model reliability is evaluated as five behavior cases times three retained runs with locked thresholds.
Public demo is static React/Vite on Vercel using recorded accepted replays and no live backend.
Public demo has no arbitrary prompt/chat input.
Target portability is Windows/macOS/Linux with TESTED vs EXPECTED status preserved.
No paid/cloud provider is required for installation, acceptance or public demo.
Scope exclusions in 01_SCOPE_AND_NON_GOALS.md are enforced unless contract is versioned.
Exact final replays/acceptance receipts are bound to final git SHA and regenerated after affected changes.
Merge/release requires focused manual user verification and explicit user approval.
